title: SC10-T1 — out through the doors (SH01, SH02)
line: I did not need to say a thing. I did not look back either.
motionPlan: Michelle walks her cart (a full-size store shopping cart, waist-high, holding a few household things) out through the open sliding doors into golden light → Michelle passes through the outer doors into the sunlit parking lot without looking back
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
